papers.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
papers.abstract: A benchmark using live financial markets to test persistent LLM agents. It analyzes decision traces, not just returns, and finds that outcomes often mask differences in underlying capability.

papers.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract: An agentic framework that generates and critiques 3D indoor scenes from text. It uses two new datasets and a critic-guided GRPO method to improve physical validity, function, and layout.

papers.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: A 4B multimodal model built on Qwen3.5 that predicts segmentation masks from its own visual representations. This improves fine-grained region understanding and referring comprehension.

papers.title: RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars
papers.abstract: A dataset of over 25K verified paper-poster pairs from ML conferences, with editable HTML/CSS templates. It supports both training-free retrieval-based and trained poster generation.

papers.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
papers.abstract: A video editing framework that combines text, image, and video references to control attributes of a source video. It includes a new training dataset and a benchmark for video-reference transfer.

papers.title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract: A simulation-free, data-free distillation method that speeds up diffusion and flow models to one or a few steps. It uses one student network and reaches strong ImageNet FID scores.

papers.title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
papers.abstract: A benchmark of 320 cumulative feature requests across 32 web apps, testing whether coding agents can extend a persistent codebase. Integrating features across requests proves the hardest part.

papers.title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models
papers.abstract: Replaces a small model's learned embedding table with a frozen binary code table. Performance holds or improves on several benchmarks while model size and CPU inference speed improve.

papers.title: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.abstract: A 500K-trajectory dataset for multi-turn image editing, built by jointly generating editing states to reduce visual drift. It also includes a benchmark and a fine-tuned open-source model.

papers.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
papers.abstract: A 1,632-task benchmark across five domains that tests whether LLMs can predict environment responses to actions. The best model succeeds on under half the tasks, and effects that propagate to dependent objects are hardest.
